figurative_meaning_en: Following a restricted or light diet after a prolonged illness
example_sentences_in_bangla: অনেকদিনের অসুস্থতার পর সে এখনও ঝোলভাত খাচ্ছে।
রোগ সারার পর ঝোলভাত খেয়ে শরীর ভালো করতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: After weeks of illness, he's still eating watery rice to recover.
She had to stick to a watery rice diet following her long sickness.
note: Refers to simple, light Bengali home-cooked meal during recovery, emphasizing traditional health practices.
